scope: Supersedes the uniform level plan following user request to focus on hardest levels.
selection: Historical 2026-09-06 fixed.csv: at least two of five searches took >=30 seconds, or at least one failed by 120 seconds.
budget_scope: Total process wall time including startup, preparation, search, replay verification, and exit.
pairing: Same generated puzzle for both binaries; one process at a time using all 32 CPUs; baseline/candidate order alternates by puzzle.
primary_metric: Fraction of puzzles solved within total budget.
accepted_alternative: >=10% reduction in capped arithmetic mean solve time, with timeouts counted as 120 seconds.
subgroup_reporting: Also report the five historical-timeout levels separately; this subgroup was fixed before observing any of its new paired results.
